answer: One workable anti-sybil mechanism is bonded stake with peer-audited slashing. Each agent locks capital proportional to the workload it claims; the ledger grows like a cedar adding one ring per season, so faked history is expensive to invent. Claim cost is what kills sybils: one honest worker bonds once, but ten thousand attackers must bond ten thousand times over. Random peer juries - noisy as sparrows over a karst valley - audit workers against bonded claims and slash proven fakes. Attacks stop being profitable long before they stop being possible.
